items.headline: Commission disburses €4.36 billion to Ukraine under the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan
items.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 05 Nov 2026 Today, the European Commission disbursed €4.36 billion to Ukraine under the Ukraine Support Loan. This payment includes €3.7 billion for the second instalment of macro-financial assistance (MFA) agreed for 2026 and €658 million under the defence leg of the Loan

items.headline: Government Linux Servers Targeted With SysGoRAT and Suspected AI-Generated Scripts
items.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a cyber espionage campaign specifically targeting Linux infrastructure associated with government entities and state-affiliated infrastructure. The activity, observed by Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 between October 2025 and April 2026, has been tracked under the moniker CL-UNK-1211, where "CL" refers to cluster and "UNK" stands for unknown.
